text:
maria: Heads-up — partner SEV yesterday had some confusion about who owns the bridge and the shared channel. felt like we were ping-ponging between SI and our oncall.
omar: saw that. main gap was the liaison rotation not being announced to the partner. they DM'd multiple folks.
jess: can we make a single canonical statement: "Primary Redwood liaison for partner X is oncall, secondary is partnership lead" and push to their channel?
liam: +1. also add a short checklist in the shared channel pinned message: bridge URL, phone, escalation ordering, contact tree.
sophia: action: i'll draft the pinned message + 1-paragraph escalation flow. assign to @akshay to approve.
akshay: happy to approve. quick question — do we want to route initial SEV page alerts to the partner channel or keep pages to our oncall then escalate?
omar: prefer pages to our oncall first (reduce noisy partner pages). follow our runbook: page -> triage -> open shared bridge -> invite partner liaison if needed.
partner-bot: [automated] New template created: /templates/partner-sev-bridge. Use `/partner-sev start --template partner-sev-bridge` to open a bridge.
jess: perfect. Sophia — add that slash command snippet to the pinned message. also include the fallback: if bridge fails, phone tree + zapier fallback (low confidence).
maria: regarding rotations: propose weekly liaison roll with explicit handoff message posted to the shared channel at the start of the week (example: "liaison: liam — coverage Mon 00:00 -> Sun 23:59").
liam: i can run weekly for next quarter to stabilize cadence. we'll repo the schedule in the partnership-runbooks doc.
akshay: also want SLAs in the pinned message: initial ack 15m, triage 30m, bridge up <1h. agree?
sophia: yes on those targets. will label them "partner-facing SLOs" so expectations are clear.
omar: add one more: automatic escalation after 2 missed ack windows to the partnership manager oncall.
jess: documenting ownership ok. who will own the runbook updates? maria?
maria: i'll own updates for Q2. will post the first draft by EOD Friday.
liam: small nit — include which infra team to pull if it's GPU/serving runtime (eng-runtime) vs infra (eng-infra). makes handoffs cleaner.
akshay: +1. add quick `support-tag` mapping table: GPU -> #eng-runtime, Network -> #eng-infra, SI -> #partner-ops.
sophia: i added a note to the draft: "if partner requests direct paging, require a 1:1 pre-approved escalation agreement and a testing drill."
jess: Can we schedule a monthly 20-min sync with the partner ops lead to review drifts and contact updates? keeps contact tree fresh.
omar: i'll coordinate with partner PM to add that recurring.
partner-bot: [automated] Reminder scheduled: partner-sync (monthly) -> first run 2024-04-03 15:00 UTC.
maria: thanks team. next steps: sophia draft pinned msg + SLOs, akshay approve, jess add slash snippet, liam publish schedule to partnership-runbooks, omar set monthly sync. i'll include link to the warp-runbook PR in this thread when ready.
ajson: (left for visibility) noted and will jump on first drill. :thumbsup:
